notes.title: Version 2.0 Released!
notes.notes: Hi Everyone! With 2.0, Power Solitaire now includes advertising in the free-to-play, with an option to upgrade to Premium version via DLC. Premium includes the ability to hide ads and more fun skybox rooms.

notes.title: Going free to play!
notes.notes: We're excited to open up Power Solitaire VR as free to play soon, in advance of GDC 2018. This will accelerate our player base growth and encourage feedback while we work on the 2.0 version. Existing paid owners will be eligible to receive free keys to unlock premium features and downloadable content when they become available. Thanks to all of you in our amazing community, Love ya!

notes.title: Steam + Windows MR Supported
notes.notes: We're excited about Window MR immersive headsets! (Available from Acer, HP and others). And we have verified that the Steam version of Power Solitaire VR runs fine on Windows MR devices. All you need is the Stream driver, see this post for details http://steamcommunity.com/games/250820/announcements/detail/1449455963851038367

notes.title: New Multiplayer mode now enabled!
notes.notes:
Stop playing with yourself. This update to Power Solitaire VR includes a unique multiplayer mode. Now you can join your friends and strangers in VR to play against others.

When I was a child my sister and I would each grab a deck of cards and play solitaire on the dining room table. One day she put her 5 of diamonds on my 4 of diamonds. I got mad and put my 10 of clubs on her 9 of clubs. Thus, double solitaire was born. Over the years on family vacations the game grew to 4 and more players at a time. It gets hot, furious, fun and fast! Now you can enjoy it too in VR.
